source_materials.text: --- title: Create Application --- # Create Application Platform: Entra ID ## Mappings - MITRE ATT&CK - Persistence - Privilege Escalation ## Description Creates a new Entra ID application to backdoor the tenant. Warm-up: None Detonation: - Create a new Entra ID application - Create a password credential for the application - Create a service principal for the application - Assign the Global Administrator role to the application - Print the command to retrieve a Graph API access token References: - https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/security/blog/2023/12/12/threat-actors-misuse-oauth-applications-to-automate-financially-driven-attacks/ - https://www.inversecos.com/2021/10/how-to-backdoor-azure-applications-and.html ## Instructions ```bash title="Detonate with Stratus Red Team" stratus detonate entra-id.persistence.new-application ``` ## Detection Using [Entra ID audit logs](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity/monitoring-health/concept-audit-logs) with the specific activity types: - Add application - Update application – Certificates and secrets management - Add member to role
